name: Space
audio_note: Brown noise (synthesized) — decided in the Sept 2026 interview.

image.prompt: Painterly illustration in a 70/30 style blend: primarily (70%) the atmospheric, painterly style of the animated series Scavengers Reign — muted naturalistic palette, organic textures, soft volumetric haze and lighting, subtle bioluminescent color accents — blended with (30%) the warm, soft style of Studio Ghibli background art. Gentle brushwork, soft diffused light, calm and cozy mood, no harsh shadows. No text, no logos, no watermark. Tuesday, a 3-year-old girl with a short chestnut-blonde bob haircut (a darker, warm honey-brown blonde) with a soft fringe, rosy cheeks and a small button nose. She looks clearly three, not a baby: a slightly slimmer face that has lost most of its baby chubbiness, longer legs and a taller, steadier standing posture, proportions of a preschooler rather than an infant. She wears soft pale pajamas and lies curled up asleep along the inside curve of a glowing crescent moon floating in a starfield, her head resting on the moon, eyes closed, a soft cozy blanket tucked over her. Soft pastel nebula clouds in deep indigo, violet and dusty rose surround her; scattered stars of varying brightness. Soft glow from the moon beneath her, gentle ambient starlight. Tuesday centered, generous open star field above and below — the calmest, stillest of all the scenes. Horizontal 16:9 landscape composition.

video.prompt: Extremely minimal motion. Distant stars twinkle faintly and individually at staggered intervals. Nebula clouds drift almost imperceptibly. Tuesday remains essentially still, only the faintest breathing motion. No sweeping or directional movement at all. Locked-off static camera: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. Slow, continuous, cyclical, steady-state motion only — nothing that builds, changes pose, or tells a story. Lighting and color held constant throughout. The final frame returns exactly to the starting image so the clip loops seamlessly. No text, no captions, no audio.
video.negative_prompt: camera movement, zoom, pan, cuts, scene change, lighting change, new characters, text, subtitles, morphing faces, extra limbs
video.audio_note: Veo 3.1 always generates audio; build_loop.py discards it
